hardware: EVO-X2 64GB, gfx1151; 32GiB reserved UMA is additional to Linux MemTotal
objective: Additional 20% generation TPS; speed first, no target quantization, KV precision, context capacity or power reduction

controls.drafter: DFlash2 Q4_K_M unless explicitly marked Q8

exact_enumeration.scope: Exact enumeration of complete target-filled sequences, not model quality evidence

algorithm_tests.limit: Checks of the verifier distribution and state replay do not constitute a model-quality benchmark.

gdn_scheduling.decision: No exact scheduling variant improved the operator by 3%

code_review.grammar_semantics: The experimental block verifier forces grammar-first on every row. The original token verifier uses the caller setting for the bonus row. Passing one constrained-JSON example does not prove the distributions match under top-k/top-p and grammar constraints.
code_review.deployment_gate: Unresolved: restrict the block path to samplers without a grammar (including lazy grammar), or prove equivalent grammar handling, rebuild and requalify before deployment.
code_review.test_scope: The timed fixtures declare no tools or output grammar. Their performance result does not demonstrate an agent-tool-call speedup.

limits: Performance fixtures use about 16K actual prompt tokens, not a full 256K live workload.
Two synthetic tasks and three random seeds cannot establish a universal minimum TPS.
Decode TPS excludes prefill; raw per-request wall and prefill timing are retained.
Generation strings differ across verifiers; only same-verifier seeded replay is expected to match.
Independent distribution checks are not a downstream code-quality or reasoning benchmark.
Fresh-seed controls precede candidates rather than a full randomized crossover; the sample is too small for a universal speed guarantee.
Minimum available RAM in candidate qualification includes image and other API checks; the control arm did not run those checks, so those minima are not a paired memory comparison.
No Flash speed optimization was tested in this experiment.

result.decision: Keep the original production runtime. Measured decode improvement is about 5.5%, with regressions in two of six fixture/seed pairs, and grammar handling needs further qualification. The additional 20% goal was not achieved.

reproduction.instructions: Scripts in the archive use absolute research paths and a private loopback port. Restore the pinned upstream source and build the Vulkan overlay with build.py before building the common-library overlay with build_block.py. The scripts expect matched-base.py at the helper path shown in each script. Trials require an idle router, an exclusive maintenance lease and the original production startup/profile files. They are research procedures, not a production installer. Preserve Q6/F16, 262144 capacity, sampling, 75W and CPU settings; performance inputs are 16K, 512 output tokens. trial_draft_q8.py also needs the pinned Q8 research GGUF described above. Do not enable the retained block prototype in production before resolving the grammar deployment gate.

swap_note: Swap-out deltas are system-wide pages; they do not imply zero SSD writes from downloads or journals.
